verdict.rationale: As a processor, the Core Ultra 7 258V is programmed through documented public developer APIs and toolkits. OpenVINO has NPU device docs for offloading neural-network work, oneAPI/oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations target Core Ultra Series 2 and Arc GPUs, and SYCL interoperates with Vulkan and DX12. These let software and AI workloads drive the chip's CPU, GPU and NPU, but they are general compute SDKs rather than an agent-facing control API, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an API reference specific to the 258V, any agent-oriented or machine-readable interface (OpenAPI was absent), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the chip through these APIs.
